name: Tensor Factorization Obfuscation
description: Replaced the direct product of dot products with an algebraically equivalent triple sum over a 3D tensor, grouping terms by registry instead of by pulse. This hides the dot products entirely. Models must now either perform non-trivial symbolic algebraic factorization to recover the graph interpretation, or fail via TLE by directly computing the $O(m^3)$ tensor sums.
